items.name: Little Horror: refined art direction and rank concepts

data.description: The Core tried to remember the ship's mascot and rebuilt it from the wreck's rot: a hairless, dripping thing of soaked hull timber and frayed rope, crusted with clouded crystal, its grin too wide and crooked. It has decided you are its crew.
data.artDirection: Hairless: no fur, tufts or fluff anywhere. A lean, low four-legged creature built like a salamander crossed with a hound, rebuilt from shipwreck rot. Its hide is slick, wet and glistening, with the grain and seams of rotten hull planks, patched with barnacle crusts. A tail like a length of frayed, tarred rope. Small glinting eyes, a mouth too wide for its head with crooked, uneven teeth. Flat clusters of clouded crystal grow on its back like barnacles, in the palette's accent colour. Eerie, not cute.
rankConcepts: A lean, hairless rot creature low on four short legs, slick wood-grained hide, a crooked grin, flat crystal barnacles on its back
Its legs lengthen and it stands steadier; the barnacles spread along its spine in a short line
Adult size, low and sturdy; ship-plank grain shows through its hide and its rope-like tail is held up
Its grin widens into a proper maw with crystal-tipped teeth; its claws look like tarred wood
The barnacles fuse into one smooth crystal plate across its shoulders, one clean shape
Seam lines painted across its body in the palette's accent colour, like caulking between hull planks
The seam lines glow faintly in its aura colour and the crystal plate lights from within
A guard of tarred rigging rope with a small crystal medallion, worn alongside any collar, scarf or charm it already has
Head raised and one forepaw lifted as if standing watch on deck; the crystal plate polished clear
The wreck's guardian: sleek and proud, its hide like lacquered hull timber, crystal catching the light, still grinning
